title: Codebase knowledge graph pilot (Graphify) - controlled evaluation before any adoption
applicability_note: D-005-REVIEW and D-005-PILOT are NON-LEDGER applicability sentinels (D-004-PHASE0 precedent). D-005-REVIEW = the capture-session review work: verbatim capture, repository-truth reconciliation, Graphify due diligence from official sources, fit/security/implementation review, alternatives assessment, recommendation. D-005-PILOT = the reserved, not-yet-contracted isolated code-graph pilot (Parts 4-8, 11-13, 18): it is contracted as a ledger task ONLY if the recommendation supports it AND the dependency-security policy permits (or the owner grants an exception per D-005-R022/R023). STANDING rows (lifecycle_events=['always']) bind both phases and any future D-005 work. affected_tasks stays empty until a ledger task is contracted (c5 requires ledger-existing IDs).

owner_approval.decision: Owner forwarded the GPT-drafted pilot directive with instructions to review fit, conflicts with completed work, execution in the current PowerShell/terminal environment, and compatibility with the recently implemented security controls; to consider simpler alternatives; to decide the next step; and to proceed on the resulting recommendation without returning for the review itself. Adoption of a code graph into canonical engineering infrastructure, any Graphify integration merge, and everything listed in Part 20 remain owner decisions on the owner-decision packet (Parts 17/19/20 and the post-block instruction).
authorizes: verbatim capture of this directive and its requirement decomposition
reconciliation against current repository truth (origin/main, ledger, directives, blockers, tasks, CI, worktree/hook state)
read-only due diligence on the Graphify project from official/current sources, including verifying the actual package name, age, license, install behavior, and network/model behavior
fit / conflict / implementation / security review of the proposal against existing program controls, plus an alternatives assessment
deciding and reporting the recommended next step; implementation proceeds on that recommendation subject to the standing prohibitions and the dependency-security policy

proposing (and, only if existing policy permits or the owner grants an exception, executing) an isolated non-production pilot in a separate worktree/disposable clone with an isolated tool environment under the Part-3/Part-4 constraints
prohibits: broadly installing Graphify into the active Claude environment (checkout, user/global Claude configuration, Cursor configuration)
running 'graphify install' against the active development checkout or user/global Claude configuration
installing Graphify hooks or any new Git hooks without separate review and owner authorization
modifying active .claude hook/configuration surfaces or the current agent confinement model
changing the product, the six future design-platform PRDs, or interrupting the current development lane
weakening or bypassing any control-plane, directive, worktree, gate, or protected-main requirement

implementing layer C (NYC evidence knowledge graph) or any Part-20 item (solver, benchmark laboratory, Neo4j, vector database, Mission-Control changes, repo restructure, Claude-config rewrite, global-hook changes)
silently waiving the dependency-age/security policy for a too-young package
merging any Graphify integration without the owner's decision on the owner-decision packet
feeding legal PDFs, client documents, plan sets, proprietary uploads, benchmark documents, or other sensitive content into an external model

notes: D-005 is owner-issued (channel owner_message): the owner forwarded a GPT-drafted directive wrapped in their own review instruction; the verbatim source captures BOTH the owner preamble and the GPT text plus the post-block instructions.

OPEN interpretation row D-005-R007: the owner preamble delegates the next-step decision ('doesn't mean that you have to bring me back') while the pack reserves adoption for owner review of the decision packet; recorded reading = review + policy-compliant isolated evaluation autonomous, adoption/integration/merge owner-gated. The owner may correct this via an append-only amendment.

D-005-R022 is expected to bite: the graphifyy package is new; if its latest release is younger than the permitted package-age window, the pilot cannot install it under current policy without an owner-approved exception - the conflict must be reported in the decision packet, never waived silently.
Pack task IDs and graph workstreams never create ledger tasks outside the M<x>-T<n> convention (.claude/rules/expansion-agent-dispatch-hold.md section 3 applies unchanged).
final_reviewed_* are populated at the independent directive re-gate.
